title: What I learned volunteering at the Thornwood Seed Library
text: The library has been running in Ashgrove since 2014, which is longer than I had assumed. My winter job was packeting: forty-odd varieties, each into small envelopes, each labelled by hand. The money side is straightforward enough, in that members pay dues and a regional grant tops it up. If you only go once, go to the spring swap.
notes: Set A. Informal blog voice; vaguest phrasing of the collection size.
